name: The Deathstalkers
summary: In Undercity, the Deathstalkers bring a new operative into their ranks. You carry Andron's Ledger to Varimathras, proof of the Syndicate's covert activities.

sections.title: Induction into the Shadows
sections.body: Mennet Carkad welcomes you into the Deathstalkers after you uncover records from Andron Gant. The order serves Lady Sylvanas as eyes, ears, and daggers throughout Lordaeron. Its agents use intelligence networks, ruthless efficiency, and stealth to remove threats before they surface. Recognition by the order marks a step into service for the Forsaken.

sections.title: The Syndicate Connection
sections.body: Andron's Ledger reveals illicit ties between local agents and the Syndicate. Once the noble aristocracy of Alterac, the Syndicate turned to banditry and subversion after its realm fell in the Second War. Carkad is surprised and disdainful that Alterac's fallen lords have sunk to petty conspiracies to claw back power.

sections.title: Audience with the Dreadlord
sections.body: You deliver the sensitive ledger directly to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter of Undercity. The nathrezim commander oversees Forsaken tactical intelligence under Sylvanas Windrunner. Pleased by the Deathstalkers' initiative, Varimathras welcomes your demonstrated ability and says his intelligence division can use someone who delivers results.

faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's order of spies, scouts, and assassins, based in the Rogues' Quarter of Undercity. They work across Lordaeron to neutralize political rivals, infiltrate hostile factions, and guard the Forsaken realm against threats from outside and subversion within.

Andron's Ledger reveals secret ties to the Syndicate, Alterac's displaced aristocracy, now given to organized banditry. The Forsaken watch Alterac's remnants in their territory, where Syndicate agents seek chances to reclaim lost land and plunder resources across northern Lordaeron.

Varimathras advises Queen Sylvanas on tactics and oversees Undercity security and intelligence. Discoveries about foreign plots, including the Syndicate's covert work, go to him for review and broader military and diplomatic measures.

Mennet Carkad is a senior handler and contact for the Deathstalkers in Undercity. He oversees field agents, evaluates recruits, and sifts through intelligence before sending critical findings up the chain of command.

faq.q: Where does this audience take place?
aliases: hall of the dark lady location
faq.answer: The audience takes place in the Hall of the Dark Lady, in Undercity's Royal Quarter. Varimathras stands beside Queen Sylvanas Windrunner at the heart of the Forsaken seat of power.

faq.q: What happens after joining the Deathstalkers?
faq.answer: With your credentials established and your reliability proven to Mennet Carkad and Varimathras, you are recognized as a trusted field operative for the Forsaken. Future reconnaissance and elimination contracts may take you across Lordaeron's contested lands.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you pledge to guard Lordaeron's fragile sovereignty from human survivors and lurking traitors.
As a rogue, you enter the Forsaken's dedicated cadre and become a state intelligence operative rather than a simple cutpurse.
As Horde, you help protect northern territories from sabotage by monitoring the human remnants of Alterac.
